notes: Credit transactions generated by other systems (POST_SYSTEM set, e.g. purchase invoices 101): no create/delete (legacy form has no numbering/insert logic), only descriptive fields, due dates and stop-payment flags are editable. Wave 3b: originating system shown (legacy list POST_SYSTEM_LIST), legacy type / supplier lists, stop-payment check box.

rules.where: TRNS_ID IN (SELECT ID FROM VN_TRNSTYPE WHERE EFFECT = 1) AND SERIAL IS NULL AND POST_SYSTEM IS NOT NULL AND (:G_PASSWORD_NUMBER = 0 OR TRNS_ID IN (SELECT TRNS_ID FROM VN_TRNSTYPE_PASSWORD WHERE FLAG = 1 AND PASSWORD_NUMBER = :G_PASSWORD_NUMBER)) AND (:G_PASSWORD_NUMBER = 0 OR (SUPPLIER_ID >= (SELECT FROM_SUPPLIER_CODE FROM VN_SUPPLIER_PASSWORD WHERE PASSWORD_NUMBER = :G_PASSWORD_NUMBER) AND SUPPLIER_ID <= (SELECT TO_SUPPLIER_CODE FROM VN_SUPPLIER_PASSWORD WHERE PASSWORD_NUMBER = :G_PASSWORD_NUMBER)))

VN_MAINTRNS.POST_SYSTEM.lov: select system_number || ' - ' || system_desc_a d, system_number r from sys_systems where system_number not in (0, 99) order by system_number

VN_MAINTRNS.TRNS_ID.lov: select id || ' - ' || description_a d, id r from vn_trnstype where effect = 1 and (nvl(to_number(:G_PASSWORD_NUMBER), 0) = 0 or id in (select trns_id from vn_trnstype_password where flag = 1 and password_number = to_number(:G_PASSWORD_NUMBER))) order by id

VN_MAINTRNS.SUPPLIER_ID.lov: select code || ' - ' || name_a d, code r from supplier where (nvl(to_number(:G_PASSWORD_NUMBER), 0) = 0 or (code >= (select max(from_supplier_code) from vn_supplier_password where password_number = to_number(:G_PASSWORD_NUMBER)) and code <= (select max(to_supplier_code) from vn_supplier_password where password_number = to_number(:G_PASSWORD_NUMBER)))) order by code
